about: Poly Haven pictures and models (CC0 licence) that were seen on the site on 22 October 2026 and may suit mediaeval and rural places. NOTHING is shipped: fetch at run time. URL pattern for a texture map: https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/jpg/<1k|2k>/<id>/<id>_<map>_<1k|2k>.jpg. Use a generic agent name in the request and nothing personal. Not found on that date: a cart, hay or straw bales, a trough, an anvil, a well, stable stalls, a thatched cottage: script those. Rules: pick a photo surface by drawing a small test plate; open every downloaded picture at full size and look for stickers, brands and digits (judgement); scans alone read bland, so designed marks and geometry go on top.
